details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
First seen 2026-10-26, in N26 and AG at [`911693e3`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/911693e3f816b32c40ee1cd8a98f390da3a18297). 4 of 4 launches in each nightly leg abort the same way.

The test passed on Oct 23–25. The rocm10 legs pass at the same SHA: nightly [rocm10](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40370684139/job/121740290001), and PR CI [`stage-c-dsv4-flash-fp4-fp8-amd-mi35x (rocm10)`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40333555627/job/121609124613) in AF, which also contains the PR.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]`: [#33250](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33250) ([`ef11eb3b`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/ef11eb3b76354ffbabd9f17a2343e79522e41cf2)) changed `test_deepseek_v4_flash_fp8_tbo.py` from `--attn-dp-size 8` to `2`, i.e. attention TP4.
The first failing nightly is the first one that contains it: it is in `8db75fc6..911693e3` (checked with `merge-base`).

With attention TP4, capture goes through `dp_attention.py:741` `attn_tp_group.reduce_scatter_tensor` on a group without PyNccl. That frame is on every abort stack, and the error names the `attention_tp` group.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: rocm10 passes with the identical config, so this depends on the environment. The PR most likely exposed an existing ROCm partial-DPA capture defect rather than adding one.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ⚠️ [#40377](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40377) names this exact abort, but has been open since Sep 19 and is `dirty`. No other matches for `hipErrorCapturedEvent`, `deepseek_v4_flash_fp8_tbo` or `tbo attention tp rocm`.
Rerun on `v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261026` with `--attn-dp-size 8`. If it passes, the topology change is confirmed as the trigger.
Then try #40377's PyNccl `attention_tp` change at `--attn-dp-size 2` and check GSM8K, not just server launch.
